CommunityApplications.Profile: Shive is a ZFS snapshot scheduling, retention and replication plugin for Unraid 7.2+. It takes scheduled snapshots of any dataset, prunes them by age or a GFS (hourly/daily/weekly/monthly) policy per location, optionally quiesces the Docker containers whose data lives on the snapshotted datasets, replicates to a second local pool and/or an SSH host, and lets you browse and restore files, folders or whole datasets from the WebGUI. This repository contains the Shive plugin only.
